D: A hotshot race car gets stuck in a forgotten Route 66 town on the way to a big race.
P: Serve the mains when Radiator Springs relights its neon and the town cruises.
S: Luigi's Casa Della Tires in Radiator Springs

Thick onion rings dunked in a fizzy soda water batter, fried until crunchy and stacked like tyres, with a smoky chipotle mayo. Slice 3 large brown onions into 1.5cm rings and separate. Whisk 150g plain flour, 50g cornflour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 300ml ice-cold soda water into a smooth batter. Heat oil to 180C. Dust the rings in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches for 3 minutes until golden. Drain and salt. Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime. Stack the rings on skewers like tyres and serve with the dip.
Oven baked curly fries with smoked paprika salt

Curly fries baked crisp and tossed with smoked paprika salt, served in paper cones like Sally's motel rooms with lemony garlic aioli. Spread 1kg frozen curly fries on 2 lined trays and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika with 1 tsp sea salt and a pinch of garlic powder and toss through the hot fries. Stir the zest of half a lemon into 150g garlic aioli. Roll baking paper into 4 cones, fill with fries and serve with the aioli for dipping.
Corn cobs brushed with chilli lime butter and charred
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with butter mixed with chilli and lime, and charred on a hot grill until blistered.
M: Beef patties with melted cheddar, bacon and fried onion, crinkle chips
Beef patties grilled with cheddar melted on, stacked with bacon and fried onion on toasted buns, with crinkle fries cooked twice.
the old Route 66 through the desert

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. For cornbread, mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: Vanilla ice cream under hot dark chocolate fudge sauce
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, whipped cream and a cherry on top.
K: Cold cola with a scoop of vanilla ice cream
Cola with a scoop of vanilla ice cream in tall glasses.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the seasoning and the lemon aioli up to 2 days ahead, aioli chilled; bake the fries on the night

steps.text: Spread the fries on 2 lined trays.
Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Mix the paprika, salt and garlic powder and toss through the hot fries.
Stir the lemon zest into the aioli.
Roll baking paper into cones, fill with fries and serve with the aioli for dipping.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the chilli lime butter up to 3 days ahead and keep it chilled; boil and char the corn on the night

steps.text: Boil the corn cobs, then drain.
Mix the butter with the chilli flakes and the lime zest and juice.
Brush over the corn and char on a hot grill, turning, until blistered all over.
Brush with more butter to serve.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; fry the chips and cook the burgers on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into crinkle chips.
Fry the chips twice in the oil until crisp.
Shape the mince into patties and season.
Grill the patties, melting cheddar on top at the end.
Fry the bacon and onion until golden.
Toast the buns.
Stack it all in the buns and serve with the chips.

veg.n: Flo's café mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Slice the onions and haloumi up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry the chips and grill the mushrooms on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into crinkle chips.
Fry the chips twice in the oil until crisp.
Trim the mushroom stems, brush with 1 tbsp of the oil and season with salt.
Grill the mushrooms until tender, melting cheddar on top at the end.
Fry the haloumi and onion in a little oil until golden.
Toast the buns.
Stack it all in the buns and serve with the chips.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the hot fudge up to 3 days ahead, keep it chilled and warm gently; scoop and build to serve

steps.text: Heat the cream until steaming.
Pour over the chocolate and stir until glossy hot fudge.
Scoop ice cream into tall glasses.
Pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the cola and glasses up to 1 day ahead; add the ice cream just before serving so it fizzes

steps.text: Pour the cola into tall glasses, leaving room at the top.
Gently add a scoop of ice cream to each so it fizzes and foams up dark like an oil can.
Serve with a long spoon and a straw straight away.

s.note: Oven baked curly fries with smoked paprika salt
s.how: Spread 1kg frozen curly fries on 2 lined trays and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika with 1 tsp sea salt and a pinch of garlic powder and toss through the hot fries. Stir the zest of half a lemon into 150g garlic aioli. Roll baking paper into 4 cones, fill with fries and serve with the aioli for dipping.

s.note: Corn cobs brushed with chilli lime butter and charred
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, then drain. Mix 60g soft butter with a pinch of chilli flakes and the zest and juice of a lime. Brush over the corn and char on a hot grill, turning, until blistered all over. Brush with more butter to serve.

m.note: Beef patties with melted cheddar, bacon and fried onion, crinkle chips
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into crinkle chips and fry twice until crisp. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and grill, melting cheddar on top. Fry bacon and sliced onion until golden. Stack it all in toasted buns and serve with the fries.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream under hot dark chocolate fudge sauce
w.how: Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until glossy hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry. Winner takes all.

d.note: Cold cola with a scoop of vanilla ice cream
d.how: Pour cold cola into tall glasses, leaving room at the top. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream to each so it fizzes and foams up dark like an oil can. Serve with a long spoon and a straw straight away.
